title: MCK-P00-S01-T01 — Establish the implementation workspace and verification baseline
outcome: Mckani has one minimal reproducible implementation workspace with real formatting, static-analysis and test commands plus baseline CI, without importing mapping, model, provider, or donor product code.
rationale: This is the first implementation candidate because every later Grain needs a real workspace and observable verification commands. It remains DRAFT until the canonical plan is merged and the pinned SpecGrain CLI shapes and promotes it.
